application_date.description: ISO date the cover is executed, e.g. 2026-07-10

owner.description: Land banker / Owner entity, e.g. DFC Anabelle LLC

agreement_date.description: Free text, e.g. 'the 27th day of September 2024'

vendor.description: Vendor name as it should read on Exhibit D

invoice_number.description: Invoice # or label (use 'RET' for retention releases)

major_code.description: From the handwritten CHECK ROUTING stamp, e.g. '1018'

retainage_rate.description: e.g. 0.1 when the invoice shows 'Less 10% Retainage'; 0 otherwise

net_amount.description: Optional; computed as gross*(1-rate) if omitted. This is what shows on Exhibit D.

source_pdf.description: Filename of the invoice PDF inside the Invoices/ folder
